// AnalyseDataProvider defines the contract for storing analysed data.
type AnalyseDataProvider interface {
	SetAnalysedData(ctx context.Context, dataTitle string, data models.AnalysedData) error
}

// Consumer reads messages from a Kafka topic and processes them through
// a worker pull model with configurable parallelism.
type Consumer struct {
	reader               *kafka.Reader
	analysedDataProvider AnalyseDataProvider
	log                  *slog.Logger
	maxPulls             int32
	jobs                 chan kafka.Message
}

			MinBytes:       1,

			StartOffset:    kafka.FirstOffset,
			CommitInterval: 0,
		}),
		analysedDataProvider: ,
		log:                  ,
		maxPulls:             ,
		jobs:                 make(chan kafka.Message, 10),
	}
}

// StartWorkerPull launches worker goroutines that process messages from the jobs channel.
func ( *Consumer) ( context.Context) error {
	const  = "Cache_Service.internal.brokers.kafka.StartWorkerPull"

	 := &sync.WaitGroup{}
	.Add(int(.maxPulls))

	 := .log.With(
		slog.String("op", ),
	)

	for  := 0;  < int(.maxPulls); ++ {

		go func( int) {
			defer .Done()
			.Info("Worker started", slog.Int("ID", int()))
			for {
				select {
				case <-.Done():
					.Info("Worker was stopped from context")
					return
				case ,  := <-.jobs:
					if ! {
						.Error(, slog.String("error", "Channel read error"))
						return
					}
					 := .process(, )
					if  != nil {
						.Error(, slog.Any("error", ))
						return
					}
				}
			}
		}()
	}

	.Wait()

	return nil
}
